rows.question: What is an exit load?
rows.text:
Exit load is a fee charged by a mutual fund when an investor redeems or sells units before a specified period, calculated as a percentage of the redemption value.

Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/faqfiles/sep-2024/1727242783639.pdf
Last updated from sources: 31 Aug 2024

rows.question: What is the exit load of HDFC Small Cap Fund, and should I invest in it?
rows.text:
The fund charges an exit load of 1.00% if units are redeemed or switched out within 1 year from the date of allotment, and no exit load thereafter. I can't advise on whether to invest; I share facts only.

Source: https://files.hdfcfund.com/s3fs-public/2026-10/HDFC%20MF%20Factsheet%20-%20September%202026.pdf?VersionId=xjdQxQp4UEchOirw4TsCE9jEGenOREzw
